# Process Review Record

Use at the end of a local issue or work plan when marking it `done`.
Policy: `docs/collaboration/process-review.md`.

## Target

- Issue or work plan:
- Date:

## Checklist

- [ ] Operating path and phase were explicit.
- [ ] Typed approvals were not inferred.
- [ ] Relied-on placeholders were filled, or work stopped.
- [ ] Contract-file changes have a trace when required.
- [ ] Review isolation followed runtime routing when an agent review ran.
- [ ] Issue or work-plan status matches the reviewable unit.

## Outcome

- [ ] No operating-contract deviation or operational problem found.
- [ ] Deviation or operational problem found (meta-level class below).

Class:

Disposition agreed with Adjudicator:

Lesson written: yes | no | not applicable

Template-feedback path: (or none)
